text:
Maya R.: FYI - I sketched a different canary schedule for the v4->v5 model swap. Want quick feedback before I put this behind the UI.

Maya R.: Proposal: 'sigmoid-staggered' ramp. Idea is small micro-steps early, then faster increases but smoothed so we avoid big bursts. Rough timeline below.

Maya R.: ```yaml
strategy: sigmoid-staggered
steps:
  - pct: 0.1
    hold: 5m
  - pct: 0.5
    hold: 10m
  - pct: 1
    hold: 15m
  - pct: 2.5
    hold: 30m
  - pct: 5
    hold: 1h
  - pct: 12
    hold: 2h
  - pct: 25
    hold: 4h
  - pct: 50
    hold: 8h
  - pct: 100
    hold: 0
smoothing: sigmoid  # blend traffic between steps over the hold window
cohorting: staggered-buckets # split by bucketed user hash to keep per-cohort signal
prewarm: true # spin up warm replicas for top N routes
failover: revert-to-stable-on-guard
``` 

Maya R.: Guards (suggested):
- error_rate > 0.5% absolute OR > 2x baseline -> halt
- p95 latency +200ms over baseline -> pause and roll back
- embedding/quality regression via eval probes -> immediate rollback
- min-sample-size per hold: 500 requests

Raj P.: I like the smoothing. Two questions: 1) do we need so many steps? 9 feels noisy in the console. 2) how do we surface the per-cohort deltas in telemetry? :thinking:

Ellie C.: 1) Agree on telemetry - we should show small multiples for cohorts (heatmap) during holds.
2) Prewarm = essential. Cold starts on the first few percent will skew error/latency.

Jordan H.: Console UX idea: show the sigmoid curve as an overlay on the step chart and let users "drag" intermediate knots. Also display expected QPS per step and estimated cost delta. @Maya R. can we show a simulated sample traffic preview? :eyes:

Samira K.: Routing notes: ensure deterministic hashing for cohort assignment so someone doesn't flip cohorts mid-ramp. Cookie pinning or a request-hash fallback is required for stateful flows.
Also: for A/B tests we should support persistent user pin across experiments (opt-in override).

Raj P.: On step count: propose reducing to 6 major holds and auto-deriving micro-smooth windows between them. i.e. UI exposes 6 knobs but engine interpolates using the sigmoid kernel.

Maya R.: That addresses the console clutter concern. Updated plan: keep 6 visible steps but allow advanced mode to expand to full 9-step schedule.

Deploy Bot: deploybot: Canary policy "sigmoid-staggered" registered in rollout-service (id: canary-2026-09). Preview token: https://console.redwood/example/preview/canary-2026-09 :white_check_mark:

Ellie C.: Telemetry hooks we need from rollout-service:
- cohort_id on every span
- sample_bucket header for correlation
- prewarm warmup_latency metric
- probe_query_results for quality checks

Samira K.: Failure modes: define a 'soft-fail' vs 'hard-fail'. Soft-fail pauses ramp and routes new traffic to stable; hard-fail triggers immediate traffic swap back to pinned version. Need both.

Maya R.: Suggested thresholds for soft/hard:
- soft: error > 1.0% OR p95 +300ms
- hard: error > 2.0% OR p99 +800ms OR quality probe fail

Raj P.: Also add an 'escrow' period: when going from 50->100 keep a 30m escrow where we mirror blind traffic to stable for an extra safety signal.

Jordan H.: UX: add a 'preview cohort' button that opens a permalink showing live cohort metrics for the current hold window. Also provide an 'export schedule' button to copy YAML.

Maya R.: Implementation notes for the API (draft):
```
POST /rollouts
body: {
  "strategy": "sigmoid-staggered",
  "steps": [...],
  "guards": {...},
  "cohort_policy": "deterministic-hash",
  "prewarm": true
}
```

Maya R.: Any blockers on infra side (autoscaler / prewarm)? @Samira K. @Raj P.

Samira K.: Autoscaler needs a small tweak to treat prewarm replicas as warm targets (not counted in burst scaling). I'll open a short PR.

Raj P.: I'll add cohort heatmap panels to the rollout dashboard and the simulated preview. Will wire the sample_bucket header.

Ellie C.: I'll add the probe query set for quality evals and tests for cold-start regressions.

Maya R.: Cool. If no objections I'll land the UI draft tomorrow and open a proposal doc. Thx everyone. :rocket:

Jordan H.: +1 from me
Samira K.: +1
Raj P.: +1
Ellie C.: +1

Maya R.: tagging product & docs for rollout playbook after we ship. "canary-sigmoid" will be the shorthand.
